title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/30232.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: How was your hunting? In this area, there are some monsters that look just like the others, but are far stronger. We call them "elders," and I'd advise that you don't confront them until you're really ready. Remember, the older ginger gets, the hotter it becomes.

warehouse/30232-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: I will safeguard anyone's property. If a unicorn was to walk in and ask me to keep his horn I would gladly add him to the account book. However, I will not teach skills merely for money. ...If I teach our secrets, we Dwarven Artisans will be out of our jobs! We can learn fr…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-01.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: I have been under the weather lately. I have found something that I desire more than anything I have ever desired before. Only one thing stands between me and my object of desire. A damn fool who insists that it is a family heirloom, with no regard for its true value. I hav…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-02.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: You are vigorous but with a cautious manner of walking, like that of a tiger with the eyes of a hawk! I can tell you are an adventurer of considerable skill! Yes, someone like you would be of much help to me. Please take pity on a poor man. A single half-wit is standing bet…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-06.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Where is my coin? What do you mean you haven't gotten it yet? Did you think I would reward you for your empty hands? I want the Kaldis's Gold Dragon coin! It's not blood dre vanul! It's not Silver Unicorn! It is the Gold Dragon of Kaldis ! Go and get it!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-07.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Ah, Kaldis's Gold Dragon! Thank you so much, I will add it to my collection. I am impressed! I was going to pay you for this, but I have another idea. Would you care to join our guild? This is a highly sought after membership. Will you join? Well, excuse me, I must gaze upo…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-10.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: You look familiar! Ah, yes, it is you! There are so many level 3 members in our guild that even I, the president of the guild, can't remember everyone. What can I do for you, my friend?

links.text: "I would like to raise my membership level."
"I want to see the list of prize items for level 1 members."
"I want to see the list of prize items for level 2 members."

"Tell me about the members of the coin collection guild."
"I would like to leave the guild."

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-11.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Long time no see! Have you obtained any new coins? I have heard tales of your business acumen. What can I do for you?

There are only a limited number of these memberships available. If you wish to reach this level you must be extremely careful in your words and deeds. Well now, is there anything I can he…

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30232-02.h.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: All you need is a Level 1 Coin Collector Club Membership Card and enough experience... Oh, I see... That doesn't describe you, does it? (Only a character who possesses a Level 1 Coin Collector Club Membership Card and whose level is 55 or above can undertake this quest.)

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30232-01.h.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Welcome! Come on in! I was about to ask you over anyway! I believe we've had this discussion before, am I right? About the special membership? Anyway, a special committee has been formed of members from all locations of the coin collectors club to decide upon whom to bestow…

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30232-06.h.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Ah, Kail's Coin! And such a splendid album! This will truly enhance your collection. Once the committee sees this, they are bound to make you a royal! In fact, I'm so sure they will agree with me, I'm going to give you the Royal Membership Card of the Coin Collectors Club. …

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30232-05.h.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Unless you bring me a rare, high-quality Coin Collecting Album from Trader Sandra of Giran and Kail's Coins , I don't see how I could give you a Recommendation... Of course, I understand that these items are not easy to come by. That's why the reward is so great... you can …

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30232-04.h.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: The monsters that inhabit the Forsaken Plains are quite dangerous. You must be fully prepared before you go there. You should leave any valuables you have with me... For safe keeping... Ha!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-03.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: I can see that you are a person of high integrity! My first impression of you was correct! Now I shall give you the details. You know Bernard, the president of the Hunters Guild? He has been showing off a coin that he claims is lucky. Actually the coin is known as Kaldis's …

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-04.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Could I have been wrong about you? How can you leave me like this? I will wager that you will return to me. I would even be willing to bet this Blood Succubus coin on it!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-05.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Go and meet with the Hunters Guild President Bernard . Take this drawing with you. It is a picture of the Kaldis's Gold Dragon coin that I told you about. Find it and bring it to me. You will be amply rewarded!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-08.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Why the long face? Don't you realize how valuable this membership card is! Do you think we ask just anybody to join our coin collecting guild? Once you get started, you will realize how valuable a membership card is. In order to trade coins with other members, you must have…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-13.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Excellent! You have mastered the skills necessary for A-Grade 2 Member Certificate. But there's a world o' difference 'tween Grade 2 and Grade 3. For that Certificate, you will need to pass a much more difficult � and dangerous � test. If you've the heart to attempt it, bri…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-14.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Aye, how time does fly! It seems like only yesterday that you joined our Coin Collectors Club, and here you are already bucking to be A-Grade 1 Member! 'Tis easier to beard a dragon in his lair than it is to earn A-Grade 1 Member Certificate, though. Still, I like the looks…

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-15.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: After holding a meeting of senior members we have decided to postpone the implementation of our special membership category for a while.

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-16.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: I hereby acknowledge your indomitable will and tenacious spirit. On behalf of our coin collectors guild, I promote you to level 2. Congratulations!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-17.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Ah! I see you have collected all the coins! I feel like crying I'm so happy! Pardon my outburst, I've made a fool of myself... It is a very special day when one of our members is promoted to level 1. Congratulations!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-18.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: Why would you want to leave our coin collectors guild? How could you possibly think of abandoning the benefits of trading coins? Are you really going to give all that up?

links.text: "I wish to leave the coin collectors guild."

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30232-18a.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Sorint: You have just come into your own as a collector and now you want to leave us. How regrettable. However, if this is what you want I will not try to stop you.
